builds.command: opam exec -- dune build --root . -j 4 test/test_keeper_approval_queue.exe test/test_keeper_hitl_replay_delivery.exe test/keeper_chat_operations/test_keeper_direct_gate_wait.exe

tests.command: opam exec -- dune exec --root . --no-build ./test/test_keeper_approval_queue.exe -- test 'nonhierarchical queue' '5,12,18,23-26,50-51,53,55-57,61' --color=never

initial_failure.reason: Direct invocation omits DUNE_SOURCEROOT, so the managed Gate replay prompt is absent. Dune exec --no-build supplies the intended test context; same binary and assertions then pass.

scope: Focused macOS compilation and isolated durable-store/chat/intake scenarios only. No live Keeper, provider execution, CI, installation, deployment, or visible UI evidence.
